All confirmed. Now I have the full picture.

h13.

**Implementation that actually executes at runtime: `*markdown.service`** (the unexported `service` struct in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:58-60`), wrapping a `goldmark.Markdown` instance. It's the only type implementing the `markdown.Service` interface in this codebase, so it's the sole concrete implementation.

**Construction**: `markdown.NewService(...)` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:85-113` — builds the goldmark instance (with GFM plus optional tag/mention extensions) and returns `&service{md: md}` as the `Service` interface. It's called from:
- `NewAPIV1Service` — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:47-51` (production construction, with `WithTagExtension()` and `WithMentionExtension()`)
- test setup helper `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44` (test-only construction)

**Holders of the `markdown.Service` interface** (all typed as `markdown.Service`, receiving the same instance built above via dependency injection):
- `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35` (the owner/original holder, set in `NewAPIV1Service`)
- `rss.RSSService.MarkdownService` — `server/router/rss/rss.go:45`, populated at construction (`server/router/rss/rss.go:62`) with the instance passed in from `rss.NewRSSService(s.Profile, s.Store, apiV1Service.MarkdownService)` at `server/server.go:85` — i.e. it's handed `APIV1Service`'s markdown service rather than building its own
- `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`, set via `NewRunner(store, markdownService)` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:19-24`) — though as established previously, this `Runner` type is never actually constructed/invoked anywhere in the current codebase, so this holder is currently dead code.
